title: Ordinary finite source and pushforward comparisons
statement: For a commutative condensed ring object R and ordinary commutative ring A, let eP and eW be finite realizations on P=ProjectiveLine Y and W=diagonalSurface Y [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-finite-realization]. FiniteSourceComparison records the isomorphism from eW(source R Y) to the ordinary direct image of the constant A module under the diagonal and exactly the supported-source underlying HEq of FiniteDiagonalComparison [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-finite-diagonal]. For f:X→S and finite realizations eX,eS, FiniteOrdinaryPushSquare records the ordinary comparison (CondensedRing.lowerStar R f) followed by eS with eX followed by ordinary lowerStar A f, and exactly the underlying-sheaf normalization required by FinitePushSquare. These structures store given maps and equations; they make no assertion of existence and choose no data.
